title: "Means & Variance"
subtitle: "Understanding the mean and variance of a variable."

::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** You arrive here from [R language](r-language.qmd). You can compute things in R using vectors and functions.

**What this module adds.** You'll learn what the mean, variance, and standard deviation of a variable tell you, and how to compute them.

**Why it is valuable.** Nearly every statistic you will meet later is built from means and variances.

**Where it leads.** Next up: [Probability & Sampling](probability-and-sampling.qmd) and [Correlation & Covariance](correlation-and-covariance.qmd).
:::
